title: Implicit Spring Joint Drives
author: PhysX Team
summary: NVIDIA describes TGS position substeps accumulating drive impulse, then holding that accumulated drive force fixed during velocity iterations. Thus reported endpoint velocity and a full-step pose difference need not agree; inserting that final velocity into an explicit PD formula need not recover accumulated drive effort.
limits: Read-only primary documentation, not captured solver iterations or proof of this installed GPU binary behavior. No solver flag, controller, gain, material, physical or quiet guard changed. Does not certify a proposed motion or waive raw-speed settling.
